compiled_state.title: Add detected_by workflow step and detected_by Field section to create-bug SKILL.md
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- dd-1: When a user files a bug with CLI_user tag in this session, the AskUserQuestion dialogue prompts for detected_by channel before creating the ticket
- dd-2: The created ticket carries the detected_by:<channel> tag (one of the 7 allowed values) alongside CLI_user
- dd-3: SKILL.md documents the AskUserQuestion call and the 7 allowed values

Modify `plugins/dso/skills/create-bug/SKILL.md`:

1. New workflow step before the ticket-create command block (around current lines 50-64) — a numbered step that, when the CLI_user tag will be added (interactive human-filing session), instructs the LLM to invoke AskUserQuestion with the 7 allowed channel values verbatim and then pass the chosen value as a second --tags detected_by:<channel> flag on the ticket create command. The step MUST explicitly gate on the CLI_user condition and MUST instruct sub-agent / autonomous callers to skip the prompt and continue using infer-detected-by.sh's DSO_FILING_CONTEXT-driven inference (do NOT modify infer-detected-by.sh — out of scope).

2. New standalone `## detected_by Field` section after the existing `## CLI_user Tag Policy` section (after current line 72) — documents the AskUserQuestion call and enumerates the 7 allowed values verbatim: tests, review-llm, review-human, production, user-report, internal-dogfood, other. Values MUST match EXACTLY the ALLOWED array in plugins/dso/scripts/infer-detected-by.sh.

3. Tag format in ticket create command: --tags CLI_user --tags detected_by:<channel> (two separate --tags flags).

Per Rule 5 (behavioral testing standard), SKILL.md is an instruction file — structural tests only.

## Testing Mode
RED — write structural tests (grep-based assertions) first; they fail because SKILL.md currently has no detected_by section. Then add the section to make them pass.

## Acceptance Criteria
- SKILL.md contains a standalone `## detected_by Field` section heading — Verify: grep -qE '^## detected_by Field' plugins/dso/skills/create-bug/SKILL.md
- SKILL.md contains an AskUserQuestion-bearing workflow step gated on CLI_user — Verify: grep -B2 -A6 'AskUserQuestion' plugins/dso/skills/create-bug/SKILL.md | grep -q 'CLI_user'
- SKILL.md enumerates all 7 allowed detected_by values verbatim — Verify: for v in tests review-llm review-human production user-report internal-dogfood other; do grep -q -- "$v" plugins/dso/skills/create-bug/SKILL.md || { echo "MISSING: $v"; exit 1; }; done
- SKILL.md values match the ALLOWED array in infer-detected-by.sh — Verify: for v in $(grep -oE 'ALLOWED=\([^)]+\)' plugins/dso/scripts/infer-detected-by.sh | tr -d '"()' | sed 's/ALLOWED=//'); do grep -q -- "$v" plugins/dso/skills/create-bug/SKILL.md || { echo "MISSING from SKILL: $v"; exit 1; }; done
- SKILL.md documents the two-flag tag format --tags CLI_user --tags detected_by: — Verify: grep -qE '\-\-tags +CLI_user.*\-\-tags +detected_by:' plugins/dso/skills/create-bug/SKILL.md
- SKILL.md instructs sub-agent / autonomous callers to skip the prompt and use infer-detected-by.sh — Verify: grep -qE '(sub-agent|autonomous|DSO_FILING_CONTEXT|infer-detected-by)' plugins/dso/skills/create-bug/SKILL.md
- Existing CLI_user Tag Policy section is preserved (not removed) — Verify: grep -qE '^## CLI_user Tag Policy' plugins/dso/skills/create-bug/SKILL.md

## File Impact
- plugins/dso/skills/create-bug/SKILL.md — Edit

comments.body:
AC amendment (gap-analysis: implicit_assumption): Specify sub-agent/autonomous-caller bypass mechanism explicitly in SKILL.md.

Amend ff45 so the SKILL.md edit explicitly documents:
1. The exact signal the workflow checks to detect sub-agent/autonomous callers (e.g., DSO_FILING_CONTEXT set, or running inside a Task sub-agent context) before skipping AskUserQuestion
2. The fallback order when the prompt is skipped: infer-detected-by.sh DSO_FILING_CONTEXT inference → (if empty/invalid) default 'other' or error
3. That the inferred value MUST be one of the 7 ALLOWED values; document behavior when infer-detected-by.sh returns out-of-set (coerce to 'other' or skip tag)

Without this, a SKILL.md that silently degrades to no tag (or an unlisted value) would pass the integration test (which only exercises the 7 explicit --tags values) while violating the story's intent that every manually-filed bug carries an explicit attribution tag.

Additional verify step: grep -qE '(DSO_FILING_CONTEXT|sub-agent|autonomous)' plugins/dso/skills/create-bug/SKILL.md && grep -qE '(fallback|default|skip)' plugins/dso/skills/create-bug/SKILL.md
